key_idea: Hysteresis rounding: outside the band round down/up by the thresholds; inside the band, look back to the most recent reading outside this band and round toward the side it came from.
sketch: Convert everything to integer thousandths to avoid floating comparisons (thresholds end in 5 hundredths, speeds are tenths, so no ties). For speed s with integer part i: 0 displays 0, 0<s<1 displays 1, fraction below tf gives i, above tr gives i+1. Otherwise scan backwards for the latest previous reading outside [i+tf, i+tr]; if it was below the band show i, if above show i+1. O(n^2) worst case with n <= 1000. Pitfalls: the band is specific to the current integer i, so the reference reading can be far away in value, and the sub-1 rule overrides everything.
